title: VTG 1986 Cats Musical Program Playbill State Fair Texas Dallas Broadway Tour
descriptionText: The product is a vintage playbill from the 1986 Cats musical production, featuring a program from the State Fair Texas Dallas Broadway Tour. It serves as a piece of theater memorabilia, showcasing a specific show from the 1980s. This item holds sentimental value for fans of musical theater and collectors of entertainment memorabilia, particularly those interested in classic productions like Cats. The playbill provides a glimpse into the history of these Broadway tours and serves as a tangible piece of nostalgia for enthusiasts of theater arts.
